_note: focus-verifier's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. POSITIVES cover the verify/check/audit-my-UI-focus families across phrasing (focus order / tab sequence, keyboard-only operability, focus management on route change, focus-ring appearance, hit-target minimums, focus traps). NEGATIVES are ADVERSARIAL: the OTHER FOUR sibling verifiers' concerns (each a NEGATIVE here, labelled with the owning sibling), plus color-science (color theory/math) and component-decomposer (BUILDING a control, not verifying its focus). NOTE: a contrast request is a NEGATIVE here — it belongs to color-verifier — UNLESS it is specifically about FOCUS-RING contrast, which is this skill's. routing-eval measures lexical overlap only; a paraphrase positive may score recall 0 (proxy limit, not a defect).
positives: verify the focus order matches the visual reading order on this form
check that every interactive element is reachable by keyboard with Tab
audit my UI for keyboard-only operability and missing focus indicators
is this dialog a keyboard trap and does Escape dismiss it
verify focus moves to the heading on route change
check that my icon buttons meet the 24x24 hit-target minimum

verify focus-visible is used so the ring does not flash on pointer click
